title: Laser Therapy in Managing Vaginal Prolapse
brief_summary: Efficacy of laser therapy in postmenopausal women with symptomatic prolapse stage \>1. Assessment tools will include prolapse stage quantification system (POP-Q) and validated condition related questionnaires.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Symptomatic prolapse stage \>1 (cystocele, vaginal vault prolapse, enterocele, rectocele) according to POP-Q System
* Negative Pap-smear

Exclusion Criteria:

* Asymptomatic prolapse
* prolapse stage \<=1
* prolapse of uterus
* presence of any type of genital infections (i.e herpes, vaginitis etc)
* vaginal bleeding
* underlying pathologies that could interfere in patients compliance (i.e psychiatric)
